text_only.description: Skip loading the vision encoder for text-only workloads — frees VRAM for KV cache. Mutually exclusive with encoder_parallel.

encoder_parallel.description: Run the vision encoder in data-parallel mode — avoids TP comm overhead on the small encoder. Mutually exclusive with text_only.

long_context.description: YaRN RoPE scaling past the native 262,144-token window to ~1,010,000 tokens. Static YaRN holds the scaling factor constant regardless of input length, so leave this off unless you actually serve long prompts; for ~524K, halve the factor to 2.0.

guide:
## Overview

[Qwen3.5-122B-A10B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B) is a mid-tier
member of the Qwen3.5 family, sharing the gated delta networks MoE architecture
with 122B total parameters and 10B activated per token (256 experts). It is
multimodal (vision + text) and natively supports 262K context.

## Prerequisites

- **vLLM version:** >= 0.17.0
- **Hardware (BF16):** 4x H200 or 8x H100
- **Hardware (FP8):** 2x H200 or 4x H100
- **Hardware (Int4):** single 80 GB GPU

### Install vLLM

```bash
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -U vllm --torch-backend=auto
```

## Launching the Server

### BF16 on 4xH200 (TP4)

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

### FP8 on 2xH200 (TP2)

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --max-model-len 262144 \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

### Throughput-focused (text-only, EP)

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 \
  -dp 4 --enable-expert-parallel \
  --language-model-only \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3 \
  --enable-prefix-caching
```

### MTP speculative decoding

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --speculative-config '{"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 1}' \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

### AMD (MI325X / MI355X, single GPU, FP8)

The FP8 checkpoint fits one MI300X-class GPU. Three settings matter on ROCm and none is on by
default: `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` switches the MoE to the AITER FP8 kernels,
`--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA` keeps decode flat across context (the auto-selected
`ROCM_ATTN` decays with prompt length on this hybrid GDN model), and `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`
keeps MTP flat across context too.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-num-seqs 64 \
  --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

`--max-num-seqs 64` because the default exceeds the Mamba block budget on 192 GB. MTP
(`--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":1}'`) works with the same
flags. Single-stream decode (tokens/s at ~200 / ~2k / ~12k / ~30k prompt tokens, 128 output
tokens, prefix caching off), measured 2026-10-07 on `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.31.0`:

| | MI325X | MI355X |
|---|---|---|
| AITER + `ROCM_AITER_FA` | 128 / 127 / 127 / 127 | 143 / 143 / 143 / 143 |
| + MTP | 184 / 169 / 172 / 164 | 204 / 193 / 195 / 190 |

This recipe used `ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN` before v0.31.0. Avoid it on MI350X/MI355X with
v0.31.0: there it runs AITER's new gfx950 Gluon kernel, which decodes at 110 tokens/s and,
with MTP, falls from 200 to 72 tokens/s between ~200 and ~30k prompt tokens
([vllm-project/vllm#60408](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/60408)). MI325X is
unaffected (126 tokens/s; 182 to 162 with MTP).

## Client Usage

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="EMPTY", base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the gated delta networks paper."}],
    max_tokens=512,
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

## Troubleshooting

- **CUDA graph / Mamba cache size error:** reduce `--max-cudagraph-capture-size`
  (default 512). See [vLLM PR #34571](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/34571).
- **Disable reasoning:** add `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'`.
- **Prefix Caching (Mamba):** currently experimental in "align" mode.
